resources.string: Draws the notification light around your camera on the lock screen and turns the screen back off after the always-on light times out. Glow LED does not read screen content or observe your actions.

Required. Lets Glow LED know when a notification arrives. Nothing leaves your phone.
Not required. Adds: instant screen-off after the light times out, and a light that no phone brand can block. Skip it if you prefer.
Lets the light appear when the screen is off. Enough on its own - no Accessibility needed.
Needed for the test notification and the fallback launcher.
Stops the system from killing Glow LED. The app itself uses almost no power in the background.
Your phone brand has an extra app killer. Allow Glow LED to autostart and run in the background.
HyperOS/MIUI: turn on \"Show on lock screen\" and \"Display pop-up windows while running in background\".

Android 13+: apps installed from an APK file get \"restricted settings\" for Notification access and Accessibility. This is an Android rule, not a bug. If a switch is greyed out: App info → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Grants everything above automatically: no Settings hunting, no \"restricted settings\" step.
Screen turns off instantly even without Accessibility. Tap to run setup again.

Charging ring colour by battery level

Ring while on: a small ring around the camera while you use the phone. Charging ring: fills with your battery level while charging. Download ring: shows how far a download has got. Both also work on the lock screen; hidden in landscape (except edge lighting).

Still after 12 s: the light animates when it appears, then holds still, so nothing is redrawn. Dim older: a new notification glows at full strength and fades over an hour. Wake on motion: after the light times out, it shows again when you move the phone, using the motion chip (no screen or CPU time while waiting).

Swipe down on a settings page when it is scrolled to the top to reveal the live LED preview and bring controls within reach. Swipe up, or press Back, to close it. Swipe left or right to change tabs. You can reopen this guide from More → Tutorial.

Tap the floating Test pill, then press the power button to lock the device. With notification access and screen-off lighting enabled, Glow LED waits briefly, then shows the black notification screen. Swipe-down preview lets you try styles without locking the device.

Open the Setup cards to enable notification access and either Display over other apps or Accessibility. Accessibility can also switch the screen off immediately. On Xiaomi and other strict devices, check autostart and battery restrictions. The progress bar shows which required permissions remain.

Style offers 11 animations, including Twin orbit and Sparkle. Choose a colour, speed, size, glow and multi-app mode. Camera position adjusts the ring around your camera. App theme and haptic feedback are in Settings; they never change the black notification background.

When an app posts a progress notification, its ring shows transfer progress. A letter below the ring identifies the app; ↑ means upload, ↓ download and ↕ unknown direction. Moving progress with no percentage uses a spinner. Use app colours, or choose upload/download colours in Screen on. Transfers without progress notifications cannot be detected.

Battery percentage can appear below the ring on both the screen-on overlay and the black screen-off view. The charging ring uses your low, medium and high battery colours; transfers temporarily take priority. Screen-off indicators respect your timeout and power-saving settings. Battery updates do not wake the screen by themselves.

On the black notification screen, tap an app icon to read its notification, reply or mark it as read when the app supports those actions. Reply may require unlocking. Double-tap to reveal the lock screen. Alerts controls allowed apps, per-app colours, silent notifications and Do Not Disturb.

The screen-off view wakes the display and draws black; it is not the device’s native hardware AOD. Black pixels switch off on OLED, but LCD backlights can still glow. Battery offers quiet hours, low-battery protection, frame-rate limits and motion reminders. More also contains backup, restore, language and the event log.

App colours identify transfers (WhatsApp green, Instagram pink). Turn app colour off to use upload/download colours; a custom progress colour overrides both. Detection needs a progress notification. ↕ means the direction was not provided.
